messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
My Dr. appt.was very quick, just had to get some ointment for some eczema I had developed on my leg.

output.original_text: My Dr. appt. was very quick, just had to get some ointment for some eczema I had developed on my leg.
output.joy: My Dr. appt. was super quick, and I was so relieved to just get some ointment for the eczema on my leg!
output.sadness: My Dr. appt. was very quick, but it’s so frustrating that I had to get ointment for the eczema on my leg.
output.fear: My Dr. appt. was very quick, but I can’t help but worry about the eczema that suddenly developed on my leg.
output.anger: My Dr. appt. was very quick, but it’s infuriating that I had to get ointment for this stupid eczema on my leg.
output.surprise: My Dr. appt. was unbelievably quick; I only had to get some ointment for the eczema that popped up on my leg!
output.disgust: My Dr. appt. was so quick, but honestly, I was grossed out to find out I needed ointment for the eczema on my leg.
